vuln.name: Django Debug Mode Enabled
vuln.description: This Django web application is running with debug mode turned on (DEBUG = True ). One of the main features of debug mode is the display of detailed error pages. If your app raises an exception when DEBUG is True, Django will display a detailed traceback, including a lot of metadata about your environment, such as all the currently defined Django settings (from settings.py).
vuln.recommendation: Never deploy a site into production with DEBUG turned on. To disable debug mode, set DEBUG = False in your Django settings file.
